displayIdentity.body: Unbelievers encounter sign, conviction, and disclosed hearts. Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature. And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
